reviews.description: One entry per labelled response. Every response in the prompt must appear exactly once.

label.description: The response label being scored, exactly as written in the prompt ("A", "B", ...).

scores.description: One entry per criterion listed in the prompt, using the criterion names verbatim. Score every criterion for every response, independently — do not form one overall impression and spread it across the criteria.

criterion.description: The criterion name, copied verbatim from the prompt.

score.description: 1 to 100 on THIS criterion alone. 1 = worthless, 50 = borderline, 100 = could not be better. Use the range: two answers that differ should not receive the same number.

reason.description: One line saying why this score rather than ten points higher or lower.

factual_errors.description: Each item quotes a specific erroneous claim from this response and says why it is wrong. Empty array if none. Style, phrasing and preference disagreements do NOT belong here.
